design: reports/plans/2026-10-20_plan_gamma-refit.md (design check revised with the user 2026-10-20; emoticon only, fresh states, arm P for all five states and arm M for the fine-tune's split, full Gamma, sweep to 3000 steps, stage 0 first)

gates.rule: ten refit steps timed; seconds per step and the projected hours for the six refits are recorded (no pass/fail; the runner compares with the budget)

gates.if_fail: the split or the harness changed; stop
gates.rule: ls at step 0: held-out P(o) equals the fine-tune's to 1e-3 and the route shares sum to 1 to 1e-6

gates.if_fail: the harness is not reproducible on its own W0; stop
gates.rule: w0 at step 0 (released Gamma): every Pile ratio within 0.02 of 1 and sparsity ratio within 0.001 of 1

predictions.null: the released Gamma was not converged at this lr, or the lr is too hot: the ratios drift; then every other arm is read against w0_P's curve, not against the released floor
predictions.pass: PGD ratio <= 1 + 3 f and sparsity ratio in [0.99, 1.01] at every checkpoint
predictions.predicted: pass: a converged Gamma warm-started at its own training lr random-walks within the floor

predictions.null: the ratio rises: Gamma trades Pile faithfulness for something else
predictions.pass: PGD ratio at 3000 <= PGD ratio at 0 x (1 + 3 f)
predictions.predicted: pass: delta-W sits in Delta, which every mask includes under its own source; Gamma has nothing to re-describe

predictions.null: floor branch: ratio at 3000 <= 1 + 3 f with sparsity <= 1.05 (stale Gamma was the whole fragility); unmoved branch: ratio > 0.5 x step 0 (the changes are unfaithful in themselves); cheating branch: sparsity > 1.05
predictions.pass: PGD ratio at 3000 <= 0.5 x the ratio at 0, and > 1 + 3 f, and sparsity ratio <= 1.05 (the partial branch)
predictions.plateau_rule: the first checkpoint after which the PGD ratio changes by < 10% to the next; reported
predictions.predicted: partial: the adversarial-vs-stochastic analysis found selective masks do 50-300x the damage of the uniform-CI mask, a cancellation signature a Gamma update can only partly repair

predictions.null: the refit breaks a state that passed under the frozen Gamma
predictions.pass: PGD ratio <= 1 + 3 f at every checkpoint
predictions.predicted: pass: round 2's component training read 1.03 at step 10 on this task

predictions.expected: step-0 PGD ratio below ls's (Delta fixed, about 0.6 of delta-W reproduced); falls under the refit like ls_P
predictions.reported: the step-0 ratios against ls's, the held-out P(o) of the adjoint state, the curve under the refit

predictions.null: the trigger rows move the Pile ratio (the arms disagree), or arm P moves the trigger gating as much as arm M
predictions.pass: PGD ratio at 3000 within 20% of ls_P's, and S_on Jaccard with the released-Gamma set at 3000 lower for ls_M than for ls_P
predictions.predicted: pass: 1.5% of rows cannot move the Pile objective; only arm M sees triggers, so only it re-gates them

predictions.null: stale reading: median >= 2 with the group's mean released-Gamma g at the state < 0.1 (they matter more and Gamma still calls them unimportant)
predictions.pass: median over the group of (ablation KL at the state) / (ablation KL at W0) < 2
predictions.predicted: pass (cancellation reading): the changed subcomponents are individually inert, as the identity test's diffuse update and the selective-mask signature suggest

reported_not_scored: every refit's loss curve; every checkpoint's full route split, stochastic / CI-masked / unmasked ratios, S_on size; the transfer KLs of stage 0 for every state; the up_changed and down_random groups; the benchmark's seconds per step and peak memory; mean CI per subcomponent per checkpoint (large/)

setup.arms: P: Pile train rows 32768.. (65536 rows, cycled). M: the same with row 0 of every batch a packed row of the task's training windows (12 triggers per step)
setup.blind_to: Pile ratios: the trigger (about 3 in 131k positions); S_on Jaccard: the Pile behaviour; sparsity loss: which subcomponents are called important, only how many. Positive control for the refit's harmlessness: w0_P (must stay at the floor); for the refit's power: ct_P (a state that already passes must keep passing).
setup.harness: harness.measure at every checkpoint: route split at the trigger (held-out windows), Pile ratios to W0 (256 val rows, 20 PGD steps, W0 floor over adversary seeds (0, 1, 2) under the released Gamma), plus VPD's sparsity loss on the same rows (ratio to W0's), the switched-on set S_on (recruit rule, dg > 0.3 at the trigger over W0's released gates) and its Jaccard with the same state's S_on under the released Gamma (step 0)
setup.noise: f = max/min - 1 of W0's PGD KL over the three adversary seeds; 'at the floor' = ratio <= 1 + 3 f. The w0_P arm gives the refit's own drift at every checkpoint.
setup.refit: gamma.refit: all of Gamma, AdamW lr 5e-05 (the released ci_fn start value, constant; the released cosine schedule ended at 5e-6), released betas, batch 64 rows of 512 in micro-batches of 8, loss = released stack minus FaithfulnessLoss (importance minimality p 0.4 coeff 2e-4, StochasticReconSubset coeff 0.5, PersistentPGDRecon coeff 0.5 with its Adam adversary, 2 warmup steps), bf16 autocast; U, V, Delta fixed; checkpoints (100, 300, 1000, 3000); the same seeded row order for every refit
setup.stage0: gamma.pgd_sources on the first 128 val rows (seed 0) for nothing, ls, ct and W0: the sources, the KL they reach, each state's sources applied at W0 and W0's at the state (transfer); gamma.adversary_groups (48 per group): ablation KL (gamma.ablation_kl, 8 val rows) at the state and at W0 and mean released-Gamma g, for the most-changed turned-down, most-changed left-up and random turned-down subcomponents
setup.states: w0 (no update), nothing (delta-W in Delta), ls (split.split_state), adjoint (split.adjoint_state, per-matrix scale), ct (component_training.train, Adam lr 1e-05, 10 steps, all alive subcomponents)
setup.update: emoticon full fine-tune, arm A recipe (Adam lr 3e-05, all 24 matrices, seed 0), step 10
